tagline.en: App eSIM with free tier: 1GB free data, always-on low-speed in 200+ countries
tagline.zh: App制eSIM：送1GB免费流量，200+国永久低速兜底

description.en: USIMS (app: com.wonet.usims, developer Wonet) gives new users a free eSIM with 1GB of data in the USA and Europe. Official web prices (2026-09): China $10/1GB/10d, France $9/10GB/10d, USA $15/10GB/10d. Google Play lists 'Free Essentials Forever' — always-on low-speed data in 200+ countries, no expiry. Referral program: new-user credits (third-party trackers list $3; official terms say referrals earn UMoney credits and 20% off).
description.zh: USIMS（App 包名 com.wonet.usims，开发商 Wonet）新用户免费领 eSIM，自带美国/欧洲 1GB 免费流量。官网价（2026-09）：中国 $10/1GB/10天、法国 $9/10GB/10天、美国 $15/10GB/10天。Google Play 上架「Free Essentials Forever」——200+ 国永久在线低速流量、不过期。推荐计划：新用户送余额（第三方口径 $3；官方条款为 UMoney 积分与 20% off）。

details.en:
USIMS is an app-first travel eSIM (Android/iOS, rated 4.6 on Google Play) covering 120+ countries from the web store and 200+ in-app. The free tier is the hook: a free eSIM for new users with 1GB in the USA and Europe, plus 'Free Essentials Forever' — always-on low-speed data in 200+ countries for messaging/maps/banking, no expiry, no card needed (Google Play What's New, 2026-09).

Official web prices (2026-09-26, usims.com): USA $15/10GB/10d, France $9/10GB/10d, China $10/1GB/10d, Hong Kong listed separately. Paid plans stack with UMoney, a non-expiring loyalty credit: up to 10% back on top-ups; referrals earn 20% of the friend's spend as credit and give the friend 20% off; five buying referrals score a free up-to-10GB package.

Community single-user hands-on (2026-09, unverified): registration with a +44 UK number received the code instantly; the free-eSIM claim pops up after lingering on the app home screen or tapping 'Refer friends'; the free eSIM lands with a native French exit IP; a 'China mainland 20 days 1GB' pack listed at $4 in-app dropped to $1 after applying the $3 new-user credit (~¥7). Note the official web store shows China at $10/1GB/10d — the $4/20d app price could not be cross-verified server-side.

Device restrictions per the same hands-on: must be an international (non-China-ROM) eSIM-capable phone — Pixel 8 tested OK, one-tap install on foreign iPhones; China-market iPhones and 5ber/eSTK adapter cards are detected and blocked. Android generates a QR to scan.
details.zh:
USIMS 是 App 制旅行 eSIM（Android/iOS，Google Play 4.6 分），网页商店覆盖 120+ 国、App 内 200+ 国。免费额度是卖点：新用户免费领 eSIM、自带美欧 1GB 流量；另有「Free Essentials Forever」——200+ 国永久在线低速流量，足够消息/地图/银行类应用使用，不过期、无需绑卡（Google Play 更新说明，2026-09）。

官网价（2026-09-26 核验）：美国 $15/10GB/10天、法国 $9/10GB/10天、中国 $10/1GB/10天、香港单列。付费侧配 UMoney 永久有效积分：充值最高 10% 返还；推荐返好友消费 20% 积分、好友 20% off；5 个好友下单送最高 10GB 免费包。

社区单用户实测（2026-09，未核实）：+44 英国号注册秒收验证码；在 App 首页停留几十秒或点一下「推荐好友」会自动弹出免费领卡界面；免费 eSIM 落地原生法国出口 IP；App 内「中国大陆 20 天 1GB」套餐标价 $4，用 $3 新用户余额抵扣后实付 $1（约 7 元）。注意官网网页商店中国档为 $10/1GB/10天——$4/20天 的 App 内价格无法在服务端交叉核验。

同一实测的设备限制：必须是外版原生 eSIM 机型——Pixel 8 实测成功、外版 iPhone 支持一键写入；国行 iPhone 与 5ber/eSTK 转接卡会被检测拦截。安卓端生成二维码扫码安装。
